sectionDescription: Manage the automatic backup schedule, retention limit, and backup history.
hintDisabled: Full backups are disabled on this server. Schedule settings are available when the feature is enabled.

settings.title: Schedule and retention
settings.description: Set when backups run and how old backups are cleaned up. Changes apply immediately.
settings.enabledDescription: When off, backups will not run on a schedule or at startup. You can still create them manually.
settings.dailyMode: At a set time each day
settings.intervalDescription: Use Go duration format, such as 24h or 6h. The minimum is 1 minute.
settings.timeZoneDescription: Enter an IANA time zone such as Asia/Shanghai or UTC. Daylight saving follows that zone's rules.
settings.retentionDescription: Enter an integer from 0 to 100000. Zero keeps all backups.
settings.invalidRetention: Retention must be an integer from 0 to 100000.
settings.saveError: Could not save full backup settings

manualSectionDescription: Trigger an immediate full backup without waiting for the next scheduled run.
listSectionDescription: Download a backup to restore it manually: stop the server, extract the ZIP over your data directory, then restart.
deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the backup file. This cannot be undone.
